\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}

1-6. Let $M$ be a nonempty topological manifold of dimension $n \geq 1$ . If $M$ has a smooth structure, show that it has uncountably many distinct ones. [Hint: first show that for any $s > 0,{F}_{s}\left( x\right) = {\left| x\right| }^{s - 1}x$ defines a homeomorphism from ${\mathbb {B}}^{n}$ to itself, which is a diffeomorphism if and only if $s = 1$ .] \end{exercise}
